steps.caption: Hard constraints decide what gets excluded — e.g. the area range and must-have locations.
Scroll to Shortlist. If the client hasn't confirmed, the shortlist is marked provisional.
One row per floor or unit, ranked. Eligibility: eligible, needs verification, or ineligible.
Fit score: how well it matches. Data completeness: how much of the needed data is known.
Flags say what to check: vacancy unverified, stale availability, seat count unknown…
Open 'Why it qualifies' to read the matching reasons.
Ineligible rows say exactly why — e.g. area outside the range, too few seats.
Set each option's status as you go: proposed, shortlisted, visited, rejected, selected.
The status is saved on that option; the shortlist count at the top of the page updates.
